summary: Reconstructed the figure as compilable TikZ: quadrilateral ABCD (trapezoid) with diagonal BD, using CV-measured vertices and bound labels A, B, C, D. Version 3 (line width 1.4pt, bold 14pt labels) compiles, passes the topology check (AB, AD, DC, BC, BD), and has critic score 0.9. Critic issues are cosmetic only: label and stroke weight are slightly lighter than the original, and the critic's suggested bold-label change had no visible effect on the math-italic glyphs.
